tests.name: build-info answers JSON (the runner confirms the verified commit from it)

tests.reason: The change is that the projector stops writing internal ORB telemetry (orb.livekit.next_action.*, orb.navigator.*, …) to user_activity_log. On staging that is a write path into the shared production database triggered only by an authenticated voice session, which a read-only suite cannot open. The suite pins the catalog, its parity with the migration seed and the Vitana Index pillars, and that neither projectOasisEventToTimeline nor writeTimelineRow ever posts a system type. The migration is proven by SQL-ACTIVITY-TIERS.yml on a throwaway Postgres and is applied to the live database only via RUN-MIGRATION.yml after Gate 2.

Neighbouring suites that read user_activity_log, mock the projector, or guard SECURITY DEFINER grants in new migrations; they must stay green with the new catalog guard and the two new definer functions.
